name: Aerodrome Slipstream CLFactory

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: owner(), swapFeeManager() and unstakedFeeManager() all resolve to one 3-of-7 Safe with no timelock, the same Safe that controls Aerodrome V1 (pauser, feeManager and Voter.governor()), so one signer set governs both Aerodrome pool factories.
narrative.tag: shared signers, same Safe as Aerodrome V1
narrative.detail: In the deployed CLFactory source the owner can set the owner and enable tick spacings (fee up to 10%), the swap fee manager sets a swap fee module (accepted up to 10%), and the unstaked fee manager sets an unstaked fee module (accepted up to 100%) and the default unstaked fee (capped at 50%); pools are EIP-1167 clones of an immutable implementation, so there is no pool upgrade path. Adding this target put two tracked targets on one Safe, which is why Aerodrome V1’s crossExposure went from 100 to 80 while its composite stayed 46.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
